_comment: skfem helmholtz#7 pollution: at FIXED k*h = 0.1 (63 elements per wavelength, nominally well-resolved) the P1 error is not k-independent -- it grows ~9.5x from k=5 to k=50 on the same unit domain, the k^3 h^2 = k*(k h)^2 signature -- while ElementQuad2 at the same h stays at round-off. Verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 on a one-element-thick MeshQuad strip (1002 P1 DOFs at k=50, h=0.002) instead of the ~2.5e5 DOFs a 2D domain would need. The phenomenon reproduces; the claimed MAGNITUDE is corrected and pinned: the k=50 unit-domain phase drift is 0.33% of a wavelength, not 5-10%; the claim's 5-10% corresponds instead to the relative L2 error after ~32 wavelengths of propagation (measured 4.8%). No measured floats are pinned. ('GridFunction' in the claim text is NGSolve vocabulary, not skfem.)
